lines.en: I drag my steps.
The cloth on me rotted long ago.
My steps come one by one.
The rusted parts creak.

lines.zh: 灰烬原野上，我拖着烂布走。
lines.en: Across the Dusting Fields, I drag my rotted cloth.
I walk the way you came.
Only I walk Dusting Fields.
My ears sit crooked.
Metal shows through my hide.
I skirt the broken glass.
Insects scatter when I walk.
I have worn a path in this yard.
I have stood here a long time.
My eyes glow green in the dark.
I smell of burnt things.
I am listening for anyone.
My jaw is stuck.
I lean, too idle to straighten.
This quiet is pleasant.
This body of mine does not breathe.
The one I wait for has not come.
The holes in me are old ones.
You finally made it here.
I have stood here a long while.
My eyes are fixed on you.
You are still warm.
We have met; you do not recall.
I have your face clearly now.
Step back; I will not move.

lines.zh: 这具身体里面还有东西
lines.en: There is still something inside this body.
Do you smell the burning?
I cannot smile; my face is ruined.
A crack opened in this shell of mine.
What is inside shows through.
I cannot make a sound.
That knocked me off balance.
Some of my stuffing fell out.
Rust flakes scattered.
I am still on my feet.
That one landed solidly.
My fingers barely grip now.
I do not eat anything.
What are you holding that for?

lines.zh: 这具身体早就不会饿了
lines.en: This body stopped being hungry long ago.
Keep it; I cannot use it.
I cannot tell what that is.
The smell does not reach me.
I want something else entirely.
Do not coax me with food.
Put it down before we talk.
I would rather you stayed.
You bumped into this old shell.
I am unsteady; I swayed.
Step back, please.
My body is hard.
You are fine; I am better.
This passage is far too narrow.
My ash is on you now.
I stood my ground and did not move.
Do not walk so close against me.
I stopped wanting such things long ago.
This body is only a shell.
That is not mine to answer.
Do not come this close.
There is nothing inside me.
Leave such things to the living.
I only want a quiet corner.
I do not understand what you say.
Go, and do not look back.
I picked it up; my hand shakes.
This is far too small for me.
My fingers will not quite obey.
It fell into one of my holes.
You dropped this? Take it.
It is coated in a layer of rust.
I hold it up; the light passes through.
I have seen many old things.
Hold it a little steadier.
I have no use for this.
Go on and run, then.
I will watch you run first.
You cannot leave this place.
I know your route.
Your warmth is fresh.
I will keep following.

lines.zh: 你想找出口，我知道在哪
lines.en: You want the exit; I know where it is.
Listen; footsteps.
You move first; then I do.
I have not had a guest in a long time.
Do not hide; it is boring.
I will walk until I reach you.
I know this game well.
You count rooms; I count you.
Then let us start.

lines.zh: 我拖着的脚步声一直在
lines.en: My dragging steps never stop.
You hid behind the sheet metal.
I go around that pile of rubble.
Run faster and you will still tire.
I have no breath to catch.
I am at the other end of the hall.
You barricaded the door.
I come in by the side door.

lines.zh: 你听得见金属刮地的声音吗
lines.en: Hear the metal scraping the floor?

lines.zh: 你越躲，我越慢，但不会停
lines.en: Hide and I slow down, but never stop.
I count your knocks on the wall.

lines.zh: 你换气了，我知道你在哪
lines.en: You breathed; I know where you are.
This abandoned building is mine.
I need not look; I can smell.
You are upstairs; the stairs creaked.
I am three steps behind you.
Your torch does not find me.
Do not stop; stopping means seeing me.
I never left this floor.
The game is not over.
I reach out and grab.
This blow comes with rust.
My arm is heavy.
You were jerked back.

lines.zh: 我的指头嵌进你的护甲
lines.en: My fingers bite into your armor.
You retreat; I follow.
This strike is old craft.
I stop once I land it.
You dodged half of it.
My joint caught for a moment.
Does it hurt? I am poor at judging.
Something rattles inside me.
Do not let me grab twice.
I missed; my nails scraped the wall.
This time I caught your back.
You backed too close to the wall.
No hurry; we take our time.
I walk out of the ruins.

lines.zh: 灰烬原野又多了一个影子
lines.en: One more shadow in Dusting Fields.
The ash on me has not settled.

lines.zh: 这具身体被丢在这儿很久
lines.en: This body was dumped here long ago.

lines.zh: 你听见金属摩擦声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear metal grinding?
I stand; every joint creaks.
I pushed the door open.
This used to be my ground.
I turn my face slowly to you.
No spawn egg, yet here I am.
Your light found me.

lines.zh: 火在我身上找到了旧燃料
lines.en: Fire found old fuel in me.
I fell and parts scattered.
Water pours through the holes.
The blast tore me further.
An arrow passed through my chest.

lines.zh: 法术在我身体里嗡嗡响
lines.en: The spell hums inside me.
I do not eat; I simply stay empty.

lines.zh: 雷光照出了我所有的洞
lines.en: Lightning showed every hole in me.

lines.zh: 这里的黑连我都不习惯
lines.en: Even I am unused to this dark.
